meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上个人微信通道:通过腾讯 iLink Bot API 用长轮询收发微信消息,不需要 webhook。手机扫码登录后,微信私聊或群聊的消息会转给已接线的 agent 并得到回复。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加个人微信通道、安装 add-wechat 技能,或做扫码登录、把微信私聊/群聊接线到 agent 时接管。

say.text: 帮我装上个人微信通道,并给我扫码用的 QR 链接
日志里出现 WeChat: session expired,帮我重新登录
把这个微信联系人接线到我的 agent group

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw via Tencent's official iLink Bot API: messages arrive over long-poll and go to a wired agent group, with no webhook. Login is done by scanning a QR code with your phone.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw, install the add-wechat skill, scan the login QR, or wire a WeChat DM/group chat to an agent group.

say_en.text: Install the personal WeChat channel and give me the QR code link
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, enables the channel, saves the QR URL under data/wechat/

say_en.text: Logs show WeChat: session expired - log me back in
say_en.note: Delete data/wechat/auth.json and restart to re-scan

say_en.text: Wire this WeChat contact to my agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts and creates the wiring
